magnetic.geometry: rectangularized E55/28/21 nominal section, 21 mm extrusion
magnetic.constitutive_model: linear small-signal screening; no calibrated nonlinear B-H curve
magnetic.rounded_corners: not modeled; local corner peaks are not saturation criteria

winding_screening.status: assumptions for screening; insulation, winding layout, terminals, AC resistance and hot resistivity not verified

e70_alternative_screening.catalog_core: TDK E70/33/32 N87, one 2.5 mm gapped half plus one ungapped half
e70_alternative_screening.two_D_FE_nominal_section: assembled outer 70.5 x 66.4 mm, out-of-plane depth 32 mm, center leg 22 mm, inner return-leg span 48 mm, half-window height 21.9 mm; rectangles and centered 2.5 mm total gap
e70_alternative_screening.two_D_FE_winding_blocks: x = 12.5 to 23 mm on each side, y = -20 to 20 mm, homogeneous opposite Jz; assumed distribution
e70_alternative_screening.mount_model: equivalent bonded winding pack with two lower-point in-plane supports
e70_alternative_screening.status: catalog plus simplified linear 2D magnetic and unit thermal-structural FE candidate; 1.2 mm solid equivalent copper, actual strand arrangement, AC/core loss and real thermal assembly unverified

thermal_structural.geometry: same nominal section, windows filled by assumed bonded polymer/winding packs; gap occupied by nonmagnetic polymer spacer
thermal_structural.heat_loads: independent 1 W winding and 1 W core loads, normalized by model volume
thermal_structural.mechanical_model: linear elastic plane stress; perfect bonds; no contact/friction/preload/magnetostriction

ferrite.basis: k/E/CTE from generic TDK ferrite ranges; nu assumed; not N87-specific guaranteed values

winding_pack.basis: homogenized screening assumptions; not bulk copper stiffness or thermal conductivity
